name: Jind

queries.query: Jind Haryana official cadastral parcel map land records GIS plot map
queries.result: First-party results identified the official Jind district portal, Haryana Space Applications Centre (HARSAC) GeoStack EODB cadastral-map portal, and the Government of India DILRMP Jind map-digitization page. The HARSAC portal advertises cadastral maps and land records for Haryana, but its current public land-query API requires authentication.

queries.query: जींद हरियाणा भू नक्शा भू-अभिलेख कैडस्ट्रल पार्सल मानचित्र जीआईएस
queries.result: First-party/search results identified the same official Haryana cadastral-map portal and Jind district land-record context; no separate anonymous Jind parcel endpoint was discovered.

registryBasis: The Jind district government portal identifies official Land Records services, while the Government of Haryana HARSAC GeoStack EODB portal identifies itself as a Haryana Government cadastral-map and land-record system. The DILRMP Jind page provides district-level cadastral digitization context. This evidences an official state/district land-record custodian, not an open parcel API for the WUP point.

officialSources.publisher: Haryana Space Applications Centre / Government of Haryana
officialSources.observation: Public portal advertises cadastral maps and land information for Haryana; map access is behind mobile OTP/public login.
Official district portal provides Land Records as an official portal link.

officialSources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
officialSources.observation: Official DILRMP page is scoped to Haryana, District Jind and reports cadastral-map digitization fields; it is status evidence, not parcel geometry.

officialSources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
officialSources.observation: National urban GIS land-mapping initiative portal; no Jind parcel response was obtained.

serviceMetadata.geometryAndCrs: Not exposed by an anonymous response; no parcel schema or CRS accepted.
serviceMetadata.safeIdentityCandidate: Native khasra or other parcel identity would require an authenticated feature response; none retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The official public viewer is login/OTP-gated and every tested land-query route returned HTTP 401 Authentication required. No anonymous parcel geometry or stable native parcel ID was verified.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made.
scopeLimits: A login wall and absent anonymous response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
DILRMP status and district maps do not establish urban Jind parcel coverage or machine-readable geometry.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, valuation, assessment, or legal/title fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is included because no unchanged native parcel geometry was obtained.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
